en.heading: 22 March: the Philippine Army anniversary traces to the Tejeros Convention
en.origin: The Philippine Army traces its institutional lineage to the Revolutionary Army associated with the Tejeros Convention on 22 March 1897 in Cavite, amid the struggle against Spanish colonial domination. Proclamation No. 2325 of 14 December 1983 temporarily assigned the same 22 March date to the anniversary of the Armed Forces as a whole, although it had traditionally been associated with the Army. Proclamation No. 447 of 15 August 1989 restored 22 March to Philippine Army Day and assigned 21 December to the Armed Forces anniversary, reflecting the Defense Act of 1935. This is a documented legal-date correction, not a second army founding.

La Proclamazione n. 2325 del 14 dicembre 1983 attribuì temporaneamente il 22 marzo all'anniversario di tutte le Forze armate, benché fosse già associato all'Esercito. La Proclamazione n. 447 del 15 agosto 1989 restituì il 22 marzo all'Esercito e assegnò il 21 dicembre alle Forze armate, collegandolo alla legge sulla difesa del 1935. Non è una seconda fondazione.

en.heading: 7 June: the Philippine Film Development Council was created by law
en.origin: The Film Development Council of the Philippines supports local filmmaking, cinema education, film festivals and the development of Filipino talent as part of national cultural and economic life. Republic Act No. 9167 was approved on 7 June 2002 and established the Film Development Council under the Office of the President, replacing the previous Film Development Foundation and Film Rating Board. The founding legislation provided for evaluation of local films, incentives to quality productions and participation in festivals and international markets. The council's legal founding must not be confused with Philippine cinema's older artistic beginnings.

en.heading: 29 October: from the 1901 Insular Museum to the National Museum
en.origin: The National Museum of the Philippines preserves and researches art, archaeology, ethnography, history and natural-science collections that document the country's cultural and biological diversity. The Philippine Commission created the Insular Museum of Ethnology, Natural History and Commerce on 29 October 1901 under the Department of Public Instruction, according to the Museum's own institutional history. The institution evolved through reorganizations and new names during the twentieth century, including the Philippine Museum name adopted in 1905. Its current founding anniversary points to the 1901 museum's creation, not a later renaming.

en.heading: 29 August: the Jones Act and the House's longer Assembly history
en.origin: The House of Representatives traces a predecessor to the Philippine Assembly, whose first session was held on 16 October 1907. This earlier elected body predates the bicameral Congress created under the Jones Act. The United States Congress enacted the Philippine Autonomy Act, known as the Jones Act, on 29 August 1916. It established an all-Filipino bicameral legislature with a new Senate and House of Representatives. The new legislative structure held its inaugural sessions in October 1916. Treating 29 August as a legal-framework anniversary must not erase the House's 1907 predecessor or be confused with the separate Senate institutional history.

it.origin: La Camera dei rappresentanti ha un precedente nell'Assemblea filippina, la cui prima seduta risale al 16 ottobre 1907. en.heading: 29 August: the Jones Act created the Philippine Senate
en.origin: The Philippine Senate was created as the upper chamber of the elected bicameral Philippine Legislature under the Jones Act of 29 August 1916, replacing the earlier appointed Philippine Commission. The National Historical Commission's Senate chamber marker says the Senate was inaugurated at the Intendencia Building in Intramuros, Manila on 16 October 1916. The founding law and first session thus fall on different dates. The Senate's institutional history also records interruptions and relocations through war, constitutional change and later legislatures. Its anniversary shares the Jones Act with the House but is a distinct chamber's founding story.
